root_cause.class: CUDA/HIP graph padding aliased live request-pool slot 0
root_cause.mechanism: When an actual decode batch was padded to C32, _pad_graph_req_pool_indices mapped every dummy row to request-pool slot 0. Slot 0 is scheduler-owned and mutable; padded attention and sampling rows therefore consumed a live or stale request's page-table and runtime state. GPT-OSS uses 8 KiB KV pages per layer/rank. Stale or hole page indices produced reads/writes at exact 8 KiB multiples below 2 MiB-aligned KV allocation bases, causing the observed GPU memory aperture faults.
root_cause.regression: A Qwen3.5 TP8 performance change restricted the reserved sink-row mapping to DFLASH and restored slot-0 padding for ordinary decode graphs.

address_proof.alignment: 21/21 current GPT-OSS fault addresses are exact multiples of 0x2000 below the next 2 MiB boundary
address_proof.kv_page_geometry: page_size 64 * 2 TP-sharded KV heads * head_dim 64 * fp8 byte
address_proof.allocator_evidence: Allocator snapshots and KV pointer logs show each large KV tensor begins on a 2 MiB-aligned segment; fault addresses land immediately before such bases at integer KV-page strides.

positive_control.configuration: C32 actual M=1, legacy slot-0 behavior re-enabled diagnostically, KV metadata validation enabled
positive_control.result: all ranks failed closed before graph replay
positive_control.message: graph padding aliased a live request-pool row expected=257 actual=[0 ... 0]

fix.behavior: All graph padding rows use max_req_pool_size, the reserved sink row.
invariants: runtime and sampling pool buffers have max_req_pool_size + 1 rows
the sink row remains zero/neutral and is never scheduler-owned
padded KV write locations remain the dummy slot

falsified_primary_causes: HIP graph runtime without application metadata corruption

decision.fusion_followup: A separate captured-output lifetime fault was fixed by persistent per-site output storage; see fused-output-lifetime-root-cause.json.
decision.final_gate: The three-block/fifteen-pair profile-v4 campaign completed without safety failures.
decision.promotion_result: rejected because decode median TPOT and output throughput regressed with confidence intervals excluding zero
